summary.text: Green Heaven Pine Wave is Song Tao Zi's famous killer move. He uses it as a peak rank seven of Wind Cloud Manor while suppressing Wu Shuai.

claims.text: In an Eastern Sea dream realm, Song Tao Zi is covered in injuries but his aura stays strong, and he firmly suppresses Wu Shuai. He calls out that Wu Shuai did not stop his killer move, then raises his head as a dense green light covers him and spreads. Traces of that light resemble pine leaves. Layers stack and sweep toward Wu Shuai in an unceasing manner. Observers already place him among the top three rank seven Gu Immortals of Central Continent, and they name Green Heaven Pine Wave. They ask how many rank seven Gu Immortals in Central Continent, or in the entire five regions, can actually defend against it.

Wu Shuai has been waiting for this cast. He enters Dragon Court and charges. The palace is completely unaffected, as if green heaven pine wave does not exist, and it easily carves a pathway. Watchers conclude that this is not an ordinary rank seven Immortal Gu House and that it can resist rank eight existences. Song Tao Zi looks at his proudest killer move treated as harmless air, and his heart sinks. Dragon Court then crushes him to death.
